meta.source: Manually transcribed and cross-validated from a Vegas odds/schedule screenshot, dated ~Sept 2026 (preseason lines).
meta.note: The 'opp'/'loc' fields (the actual matchups, home/away, and bye weeks) are fixed for the season and safe to use as-is. The 'fallbackSpread' fields are a SNAPSHOT of the point spread at transcription time and will be stale by the time this app is used in-season -- they exist only as a fallback/seed value for weeks the live odds API can't yet cover (e.g. weeks far in the future) or if the API call fails. Always prefer live odds when available.
